recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not restore the obsolete nested BodySite choice for FHIR-5167; any future change to CodeableReference or another harmonized pattern should wait for a final applied work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5167 was a Published Patient Care ballot issue asking for more consistent body-site modeling across Condition and Procedure. Its persuasive-with-modification resolution chose a repeating bodySite element with nested site[x] allowing CodeableConcept or Reference(BodySite).
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5167 was found. Legacy 2015 body-site commits introduced the BodySite resource, made Procedure bodySite repeatable, and renamed Condition.location to Condition.bodySite; BodySite was later renamed to BodyStructure in 2017.
additional_context: Later applied Patient Care issues supersede the exact 2015 nested site[x] shape. FHIR-39630 added Condition.bodyStructure 0..1 Reference(BodyStructure) with mutual exclusion from bodySite, FHIR-39288 added the same pattern to Procedure, and FHIR-51792 restored Procedure.bodyStructure to 0..1 after FHIR-41690. Current unresolved CodeableReference harmonization proposals are not final decisions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini shows Condition, Procedure, and BodyStructure are active resources, and current Condition/Procedure XML defines bodySite as CodeableConcept plus bodyStructure as Reference(BodyStructure) with invariants preventing simultaneous use.

related_jiras.note: Applied Condition decision adding bodyStructure as the reference alternative to coded bodySite.

Applied Procedure decision restoring bodyStructure cardinality to 0..1 after FHIR-41690.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification ballot issue requesting consistent body-site modeling for Condition and Procedure using bodySite site[x] as CodeableConcept or Reference(BodySite).
evidence_items.learned: The legacy WG intent was consistent support for coded and referenced anatomical location, not preservation of an obsolete source shape after later decisions.

evidence_items.summary: Legacy 2015 commits made Procedure bodySite repeatable and renamed Condition.location to Condition.bodySite without explicitly mentioning FHIR-5167.
evidence_items.learned: The seed appears to have been implemented through nearby ballot-era bodySite work rather than a Jira-keyed commit.

evidence_items.summary: source/fhir.ini lists BodyStructure, Condition, and Procedure as active resources and notes that BodySite became BodyStructure.
evidence_items.learned: The current build scope uses BodyStructure as the active referenced-resource name.

evidence_items.summary: Applied Condition issue requiring Condition.bodyStructure 0..1 Reference(BodyStructure), a mutual-exclusion invariant, and removal of the old extension comment.
evidence_items.learned: Condition's current separate bodyStructure reference is an intentional later application, not a missed FHIR-5167 change.

evidence_items.summary: Applied Procedure issue requiring Procedure.bodyStructure 0..1 Reference(BodyStructure), a mutual-exclusion invariant, and removal of the old extension comment.
evidence_items.learned: Procedure's current separate bodyStructure reference intentionally aligns with the later Condition pattern.

evidence_items.summary: Current source defines bodySite as CodeableConcept and bodyStructure as Reference(BodyStructure) with invariants preventing simultaneous use.
evidence_items.learned: The in-build source already gives implementers the coded-or-referenced body-site pattern required by the issue family.

evidence_items.summary: 2026 discussion lists the current Procedure pattern and competing future harmonization options, including unresolved CodeableReference alternatives.
evidence_items.learned: Community discussion confirms the current pattern is deliberate and that harmonization alternatives remain future work rather than final FHIR-5167 fallout.
